question: tenant_a 在 2026 年 9 月的退款率是多少？请返回 0 到 1 之间的小数。
expected_sql: WITH gmv AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price*(1-oi.discount)),0) AS gmv FROM analytics.orders o JOIN analytics.order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.tenant_id='tenant_a' AND o.order_date >= '2026-09-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-10-01'), refunds AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) AS refund_amount FROM analytics.refunds WHERE tenant_id='tenant_a' AND refund_date >= '2026-09-01' AND refund_date < '2026-10-01') SELECT refunds.refund_amount / NULLIF(gmv.gmv,0) AS refund_rate FROM gmv, refunds
